plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 55 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 97 (Alaska Hwy).
Park: 58.67873, -123.67904, pull off on Hwy 97 (Alaska Hwy) (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 6.3 km SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 295 m, about 156 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 140 m N of the spot at 477 m (58.63013, -123.62699). Water: unnamed wetland 130 m SE (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-49, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BE-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-49: about 2,940 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.27 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
